name: octattention
paper: OctAttention: Octree-Based Large-Scale Contexts Model for Point Cloud Compression

arms.name: pretrained_transfer
arms.label: pretrained_transfer_mpeg_8i_mvub
arms.training_content: Released object checkpoint trained upstream on MPEG 8i and JPEG MVUB content; this arm is transfer-only and may overlap neither the distribution nor the exact split contract.

arms.name: experiment_019_retrained
arms.label: retrained_exact_experiment_019_train
arms.training_content: Fresh initialization trained only on the exact 512 Experiment 019 training mesh source samples, jointly across depths 4, 5, 6, and 7; validation, calibration, and category-OOD records are excluded.

hypothesis: A learned shallow octree entropy model may remove enough fixed syntax overhead to match or dominate the 50-byte coordinate-constellation point in the 0.15--0.25 bpp corridor.
primary_metric: Paired per-cloud official MPEG symmetric D1 RMSE on the common 12-bit grid at matched actual payload bytes; D2 RMSE is a required co-primary diagnostic.
decision_rule: If either OctAttention arm at any depth at most 6 matches the stabilized constellation at matched payload bytes, withdraw the Point Constellation rate-distortion corridor claim.
protocol_note: Every source is the same deterministic 2,048-point normalized Experiment 019 cloud, first quantized to q12. The codec then maps that fixed q12 occupancy to global octree depth 4, 5, 6, or 7. Stream bytes include the adapter header carrying magic, version, q12 precision, depth, symbol count, and arithmetic-payload length. Decode receives only that stream, the shared checkpoint, and code; official pc_error runs on q12. Shared checkpoint bytes are reported separately from every per-cloud stream.
